# `third_party/jetski/cli/acp` Reconstruction Notes (agy v1.5.10)

Reconstructed 1:1 from `/Users/mac/.local/bin/agy` (v1.5.10, ARM64) disassembly, `__DATA_CONST.__go_type` reflection metadata, and `jetski-functions.jsonl`.
Covers **44 Go files** across 11 packages (`acp`, `auth`, `jsonrpc`, `mcp`, `messages`, `router`, `schema`, `server`, `session`, `sessionconfig`, `stepview`), accounting for all **660** non-autogenerated functions in `third_party/jetski/cli/acp/`.

## Key Recovered Behaviors

### 1. CLI Entry, Flags, Logging & Interactive Login (`acp` root)
- **`options.go`**: Registers all 25 flags (`--stdio`, `--process-per-session`, `--worker`, `--agent`, `--ide-mcp-port`/`--ide_mcp_port`, `--add-dir`, `--sandbox`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `--login`, `--include-default-customizations`, `--log-file`/`--cli_log_file`, `--gemini_dir`/`--gemini-dir`, `--app_data_dir`/`--app-data-dir`, `--cli_dir_name`, `--cloud_code_endpoint`, `--disable_telemetry`/`--disable-telemetry`, `--is_google3_workspace`, `--is_google_internal`, `--use_stubby_auth`, `--override_user_agent_name`). `extractPreSubcommandGoogleEnvFlag` scans args before `acp` for `--is_google3_workspace`/`--is_google_internal`. `applyExperimentModelOverride` reads `AGY_CLI_MODEL_EXPERIMENT_PROFILE`. `runWith` defaults `GeminiDir=".gemini"`, `Version="0.2.0"`, `CloudCodeServerURL=CLOUD_CODE_URL || "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com"`, sets `analytics.SetSurface("acp")`, redirects stdout/stderr to log file, and dispatches `--login`, `server.Serve` (single-process or `--worker`), or `runRouter` (`--process-per-session`).
- **`cli_helpers.go`**: `redirectOutputForACP` creates `acp-{front|worker.<pid>}-YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS-<pid>.log` under `<logDir>/log/`, opens with `0644` (`O_CREATE|O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC`), redirects stdout/stderr via `termio.Redirect`, and tees `logsink.Text` via `writerSink`.
- **`login.go`**: `runLoginCommand` / `runLogin` implements `--login` via `backend.NewServerBackend` (`loginFlow`), printing the OAuth URL, reading the pasted auth code/URL via `readAuthCode`, waiting on `outcomeCh` with timeout, and verifying `auth.NewBackendTokenStore` + `auth.RememberMethod(appDataDir, "oauth-personal")`.

### 2. JSON-RPC 2.0 Transport (`jsonrpc/jsonrpc.go`)
- **`Stream.ReadMessage` / `WriteMessage`**: Auto-detects NDJSON (first non-whitespace byte `{`) vs HTTP-style `Content-Length: N\r\n\r\n` framing (`hasHeaders atomic.Bool`), mirroring the peer's framing on writes and compacting multi-line NDJSON via `encoding/json.Compact`.
- **`Conn.Run` / `Call` / `failPendingCalls`**: Dispatches incoming requests in goroutines tracked by `sync.WaitGroup`, matches responses by `NormalizeID` (trimmed quotes/whitespace) to `pending` map entries, fails all pending calls with `-32603` (`"connection closed"`) on EOF/close, and supports bidirectional `Call(ctx, method, params, result)` with incrementing decimal string IDs.

### 3. Process-per-Session Router (`router/router.go`)
- **`Router.Run` / dispatch**: Routes `initialize` (cached `initResp`), `authenticate` (notifies all live workers), `logout` (closes all workers, forwards to one), `session/new` (spawns worker, forwards, binds `sessionID -> worker`), `session/load` & `session/resume`, `session/list` (uses ephemeral worker if none alive), `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`, `session/set_mode`, `session/set_model`, `session/set_config_option`, `session/close` (terminates worker), and `$/cancel_request`.
- **ID rewriting & worker lifecycle**: Rewrites outbound worker->client request IDs as `"front-<seq>"`, tracks `pending` and `outbound` calls, and kills/cleans up workers on `Shutdown`.

### 4. Server Lifecycle, Backend Boot & Auth Handlers (`server/{serve,server,launcher,boot,auth_handlers}.go`)
- **`Serve`**: Constructs `Server`, wires `OnSignal` (`SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`), starts `watchParent` (2s `os.Getppid()` poll) when `--worker` is set, and runs `shutdownWithin(3*time.Second, s.Shutdown)` on exit.
- **`bootBackend` / `bootWithBootMuHeld` / `rebindBackendFromCallback`**: Resolves `BackendSelection`, launches `language_server.CreateLanguageServerAndServe` (managing `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_URL`), adds `WorkingDir` + `AddDirs` workspace folders, reads `cache/default_project_id.txt`, wraps `acpLanguageServer` (injecting per-turn overlay), preloads `ide-tools` MCP on `--ide-mcp-port`, wires `acpAuthManager` + `SubscribeToSummaries` + CLI settings, and supports live backend rebinding when auth switches between CCPA and Gateway/Vertex.
- **`handleInitialize` / `handleAuthenticate` / `handleLogout` / `requireAuth`**: Negotiates capabilities & `AdvertisedMethods`, tracks `pendingAuth` for `$/cancel_request`, enforces auth with `-32000`, and cancels/closes all active sessions on `logout`.

### 5. Auth Subsystem (`auth/*.go`)
- **`clientsupport.go` / `methods.go`**: Parses `caps.Auth.Meta["gateway"]` and `caps.Auth.Terminal`; builds `knownAuthMethods` (`oauth-personal`, `oauth-business`, `gemini-api-key`, `agent-platform`, `gateway`); checks `AGY_ACP_ENABLE_GATEWAY_AUTH`.
- **`config_resolution.go`**: Resolves `settings.json` / MDM admin settings / `_meta.gateway` / env vars (`ResolveBackendSelection`, `resolveGateway`, `resolveVertexConfig`), strips `user-agent` headers, and persists last auth method in `acp-auth-state.json`.
- **`oauth_loopback.go` / `manager.go`**: Loopback `localhost:0` OAuth2 + S256 PKCE flow (`subtle.ConstantTimeCompare` on state, `sync.Once` callback), `Manager` state machine (`EnsureAuthenticated`, `Authenticate`, `authenticateOAuthPersonal`, `authenticateOAuthBusiness` + `resolveEnterpriseLicense`, `authenticateGeminiAPIKey`, `authenticateAgentPlatform`, `authenticateGateway`, `Logout`).

### 6. Session, Turn, Updates, Config & Stepview (`server/*.go`, `session/*.go`, `sessionconfig/models.go`, `stepview/*.go`, `schema/*.go`, `messages/*.go`, `mcp/mcp.go`)
- **`session/{state,stream,turn}.go`**: `State` deduplicates steps/text/thought/toolcall/item/permission/question/usage and sweeps pending tool calls; `Stream` delivers updates with detach hold channel; `Turn`/`Lease`/`Fence` manages `AcquireTurn` (steer/yield/cancel/blocked) and 5s `holdTurnWithMuHeld` grace.
- **`server/{session_handlers,prompt,promptcontent,updates,turn_cancel,config_options,elicitation,modes,permissions,integrations,settings,settingsprovider,telemetry}.go`**: Full session new/load/resume/list/close/cancel handlers, prompt validation (`-32602`) & turn execution, streaming updates, `ask_question` elicitation, `stopConversationTree`/`ForceStopTree`, model/thought/mode config options, and CLI settings persistence.
- **`sessionconfig/models.go` & `stepview/{stepview,relpath}.go`**: Effort-level grouping (`low`/`medium`/`high`/`xhigh`/`max`) and `KindTitleAndLocations` across all 22 tool-name groups + `ask_permission`.
- **`schema/*.go`, `messages/*.go`, `mcp/mcp.go`**: Exact JSON-tagged protocol structs, `ContentBlock`/`ToolCallContent`/`SessionUpdate` `MarshalJSON` discriminators, and `Names.Assign` SHA-256 fingerprint deduplication + `IDEPortSpec` (`nc 127.0.0.1`).

## Uncertainties & `[unrecovered]` Areas
- Some deeply inlined protobuf builder literals (`language_server.LanguageServerConfig` in `options.go:runWith`, `analytics.ACPClientConnected` in `auth_handlers.go`) and `log.Infof`/`log.Errorf` wrapper variants vs `google3/base/go/log.ctxlogf` have local/glue marked `/* inferred */`.
- Helper-level uncertainties (e.g. exact `error` code constants in some `server/` handlers, `replayHistory` timer/sleep edge cases, `auth/manager.go` some indirect interface method calls) are marked inline with `/* inferred */` or `// [unrecovered]`.
